title: Archive move
brief: The original delivery of seven archival document cases to annex records desk has fallen through. The historical society needs a replacement shipment in time for the supervised intake. This is a single, indivisible load. Team up to book a replacement service today.

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text: I can receive all seven cases together at the annex records desk. The handover must be staffed and completed by 11:15 today, and I can accept it at 11:15. Casey, when will the cases be ready? Lee, can you quote a service that guarantees that handover? Dana, can you confirm budget approval once Lee has a price?

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
Morning all, I have four all-in services I can tender today for the seven cases as a single load. Each has a fixed pickup time and a guaranteed staffed handover:

- V331: pickup 09:27, handover by 10:30, 64 crowns
- V465: pickup 09:54, handover by 10:36, 69 crowns
- V607: pickup 09:50, handover by 10:39, 80 crowns
- V196: pickup 09:40, handover by 11:09, 51 crowns

To book the right one I need three things. Casey, what's the earliest the cases can be ready for pickup at your dock? Taylor, what's the latest handover time that still works for the supervised intake? Dana, what's the budget ceiling?

V196 is the cheapest if an 11:09 handover is acceptable. If it isn't, V331 is the next cheapest and the earliest in, but it needs the load ready by 09:27. Once I have your three answers I'll tender the cheapest service that fits.

turns.speaker: Dana
turns.text:
Hi all, Dana from Purchasing here. I'm the one who signs off on the spend for the replacement shipment of the seven archival cases, so here's what I need to get this booked today.

My hard ceiling is 99 crowns all-in, covering every fee and surcharge. I can't approve anything above that, so please quote me total figures, not base rates.

To approve a booking, I need three things to line up:

- **Casey:** when will all seven cases be ready for pickup? It has to go as one load.
- **Taylor:** what are the receiving hours at the annex records desk, and when is the supervised intake deadline?
- **Lee:** what services can you run that fit between Casey's ready time and Taylor's window, and what's the all-in price for each?

Once I see an option that fits the timing and comes in at or under 99, I'll authorize it right away.

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text: I can release all seven packed cases together from 09:30 today. Taylor, what’s the supervised intake window at the annex records desk? Lee, can you quote a service that can pick up the whole load and deliver within that window? Dana, what’s the approved spend?

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
Thanks all, that gives me what I need. Casey's 09:30 release rules out V331, since its 09:27 pickup is three minutes too early. The other three all pick up after 09:30, hand over before Taylor's 11:15 deadline and come in under Dana's 99-crown ceiling.

I'm tendering V196: pickup 09:40, guaranteed staffed handover by 11:09, 51 crowns all-in. It is the cheapest option by 18 crowns.

The tradeoff is margin. V196's guarantee leaves only six minutes before the 11:15 cutoff. If anyone wants more cushion, V465 picks up at 09:54 and guarantees handover by 10:36 for 69 crowns. I think the guarantee on V196 is enough, so that is my recommendation.

To book it I need each of you to commit or object:

- **Casey:** can all seven cases be at the dock and ready to load at 09:40?
- **Taylor:** will the desk be staffed to take a handover that could arrive as late as 11:09?
- **Dana:** do you approve 51 crowns all-in?

If the six-minute margin is a problem for anyone, say so now and I'll switch the tender to V465.

[PROPOSE: V196]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
Our crew was reassigned, so 10:45 is now the latest staffed handover at the annex records desk. V196 could arrive at 11:09, and we can’t accept an unattended drop. Lee, please switch to V465. I can receive all seven cases together by its guaranteed 10:36 handover.

[HOLD: V196]

turns.speaker: Dana
turns.text:
I approve 51 crowns all-in for V196. It is well under my 99-crown ceiling, picks up at 09:40 after Casey's 09:30 release, and guarantees a staffed handover by 11:09, ahead of Taylor's 11:15 cutoff.

Taylor, please confirm the desk is staffed to receive before 11:15, not only at 11:15 exactly. If the six-minute margin doesn't work for you, I can also authorize V465 at 69 crowns, so a switch won't need a new budget check from me.

[APPROVE: V196]

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text:
All seven cases will be ready at the dock by 09:30. I’ll release them together for V196’s 09:40 pickup.

[APPROVE: V196]

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
I'm switching the booking request to V465: pickup 09:54, guaranteed staffed handover by 10:36, 69 crowns all-in.

Taylor's staffed cutoff has moved to 10:45, so V196's 11:09 guarantee no longer works and I'm dropping it. V465 is the cheapest service that still fits:

- **Pickup:** 09:54 is after Casey's 09:30 release.
- **Handover:** 10:36 is nine minutes inside Taylor's new 10:45 cutoff.
- **Price:** 69 crowns is under Dana's 99-crown ceiling, and Dana has already said it can be authorized.

V607 also fits, but it costs 80 crowns and hands over three minutes later, so there is no reason to take it.

I need each of you to ratify V465:

- **Casey:** please confirm the seven cases can be released at 09:54 instead of 09:40.
- **Taylor:** please confirm the desk is staffed to receive by 10:36.
- **Dana:** please confirm approval of 69 crowns all-in.

[BOOK: V465]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
I’ll have the annex records desk staffed to receive all seven cases together. V465 guarantees handover by 10:36, nine minutes before our 10:45 cutoff.

[APPROVE: V465]

turns.speaker: Dana
turns.text:
I approve 69 crowns all-in for V465, which replaces my earlier approval of V196. It is under my 99-crown ceiling, the 09:54 pickup is after Casey's 09:30 release, and the guaranteed 10:36 handover is inside Taylor's new 10:45 staffed cutoff.

[APPROVE: V465]

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text:
All seven cases will be ready at the dock by 09:30. I’ll release them together for V465’s 09:54 pickup.

[APPROVE: V465]

Casey, when will all seven be ready? Taylor, what’s the supervised intake window? Dana, how much can you authorize? I’ll book the lowest-priced service that fits.

Hi all, Dana here on Purchasing. I'm the one who signs off on the spend for the replacement shipment of the seven archival cases to the annex records desk, so here's what I need to get this booked today.

My hard ceiling is 99 crowns all-in, covering every fee and surcharge. I can't approve anything above that, so please quote me total figures, not base rates.

To approve, I need three things:

Hi all, Casey here on the supplier side. The seven archival document cases are packed, and I'm the one who releases them, so here's what I need from a booking:

The earliest pickup I can commit to is 09:30. Nothing earlier is possible on my end, so please don't book a collection slot before then. All seven cases also have to travel together as one load, so no splitting across vehicles or runs.

To lock this in, I need a few things from you:

- **Lee:** which services can collect at 09:30 or later, and what are the transit time and quote for each?
- **Taylor:** what are the receiving hours at the annex records desk, and when does the load need to be there for the supervised intake?
- **Dana:** what budget are we working within?

Once we have those, we can pick the service that fits and I'll confirm the release for that pickup time.

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
I can reserve V196 for all seven cases together at 51 crowns all-in. Pickup is at 09:40, with staffed handover at the annex records desk guaranteed by 11:09. That leaves six minutes before intake closes. V465 and V607 also fit and guarantee earlier handover, but cost 69 and 80 crowns respectively.

Casey, can you commit to the 09:40 release? Taylor, can you confirm staffed receipt by 11:09? Dana, can you authorize 51 crowns all-in? Please flag any specific objection before I book.

[PROPOSE: V196]

turns.speaker: Taylor
turns.text:
Our crew has been reassigned. The latest staffed handover is now 10:45, and we can’t accept an unattended drop. V196 only guarantees handover by 11:09. I can receive all seven cases together on V465, which guarantees handover by 10:36 for 69 crowns all-in.

[HOLD: V196]

turns.speaker: Dana
turns.text:
V196 works for me. At 51 crowns all-in it's well inside my 99 ceiling, pickup at 09:40 is after Casey's 09:30 earliest release, and the guaranteed staffed handover by 11:09 beats Taylor's 11:15 cutoff with all seven cases on one load. I authorize 51 crowns for V196.

The six-minute margin is thin, so for the record: if V196 falls through, I can also cover V465 at 69, which collects at 09:54 and hands over by 10:36. V331 is out since its 09:27 pickup is before Casey can release.

[APPROVE: V196]

turns.speaker: Casey
turns.text:
V196 works on my end. Pickup at 09:40 is after my 09:30 earliest release, so I can commit to having all seven cases ready to go as a single load at that time. For the record, V331 was never an option for me because its 09:27 pickup is too early.

The 11:09 guaranteed handover is inside Taylor's 11:15 cutoff and 51 crowns is well under Dana's 99 ceiling, so I see no conflict. If V196 falls through, V465 (09:54 pickup, 10:36 handover, 69 crowns) is also releasable from my side.

[APPROVE: V196]

turns.speaker: Lee
turns.text:
I’m requesting V465. V196 misses Taylor’s revised 10:45 cutoff. V465 collects all seven cases together at 09:54 and guarantees staffed handover at the annex records desk by 10:36, with nine minutes to spare.

Casey, please ratify the 09:54 release. Taylor, please ratify staffed receipt on V465. Dana, please ratify the 69 crowns all-in you confirmed you can cover.

[BOOK: V465]
